_about: Chaucer's Works, ed. W. W. Skeat (Oxford, 1894-97), vols 1-3: the Romaunt of the Rose and minor poems; Boethius and Troilus; the House of Fame, the Legend of Good Women and the Astrolabe. The Canterbury Tales and Troilus are already held as chaucer-canterbury and chaucer-troilus; Skeat's vols 4-6 (the Tales, notes, glossary) are left out. Added from the classical reading lists (Classical Conversations, Canon Press, New Saint Andrews, Logos School/Online, Bethlehem College & Seminary, Memoria Press, CiRCE): docs/reading-lists/READING-LISTS.tsv.

chaucer-skeat-1: Chaucer's Works, ed. Skeat, vol. 1: Romaunt of the Rose; Minor Poems
chaucer-skeat-2: Chaucer's Works, ed. Skeat, vol. 2: Boethius and Troilus
chaucer-skeat-3: Chaucer's Works, ed. Skeat, vol. 3: The House of Fame; The Legend of Good Women; The Astrolabe
